blocks.text: ABUCAY, BATAAN — Former Abucay Mayor Liberato “Pambato” Santiago Jr. died Sunday afternoon (Nov. 1) at the age of 89, according to his son-in-law, incumbent Mayor Erik Martel, who announced the news on social media. The cause of Santiago’s death was not publicly disclosed. Santiago was a successful businessman before entering politics. He first became mayor after winning the 1998 elections and served until 2007. READ: ‘Abucay Line’ in Bataan held, recreated WWII battle shows He returned to the mayoralty in 2016 and held the post until 2022.
